items.headline: U.S. Orders Non-Essential Diplomatic Staff to Evacuate Saudi Arabia Amid Regional Attacks
items.summary: The U.S. State Department has ordered non-essential diplomatic staff and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia following recent drone and missile strikes targeting civilian airports and critical infrastructure. The mandatory departure highlights mounting security risks in the Middle East that are disrupting international travel, diplomatic operations, and global energy markets.

items.headline: U.S. Proposes Limits on Foreign High-Tech Investments

items.headline: 2026 World Series Begins as Brewers and Rays Battle for First Franchise Titles
items.summary: The 2026 Major League Baseball World Series opens on October 23 at American Family Field, featuring a Game 1 matchup between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Tampa Bay Rays. Because neither organization has ever won a Fall Classic, this championship series is guaranteed to crown a first-time champion.

items.headline: Emmy-Winning Actor Tom Skerritt Dies at Age 93
items.summary: Emmy-winning actor Tom Skerritt, celebrated for his roles in iconic films such as Top Gun and Alien, has died at the age of 93. His family announced on October 22 that the Hollywood veteran passed away from natural causes.
